In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established a temporary prefabricated '''base''' on [[Kile]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Zhar/Legends|Zhar]], to support the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Striking from the Kile base, Rogue Squadron conducted a [[Battle of Gall|raid]] on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] interests stationed at the nearby moon [[Gall/Legends|Gall]].
